reasons.plausibility: Minor boron additions to improve grain boundary cohesion without disrupting the caloric transformation is scientifically sound, though there may be minor uncertainties.
reasons.testability: A side-by-side comparison of boron-doped and undoped samples with identical processing and caloric measurements is straightforward and decisive.
reasons.usefulness: Successfully achieving enhanced mechanical integrity without sacrificing the alloy’s caloric performance addresses a critical need in solid-state refrigeration materials.
